newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: SOCCER-Gray out of All Whites team vs Australia.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-Gray out of All Whites team vs Australia.

text.p: Experienced All Whites defender Rodger Gray was again omitted when New Zealand coach Joe McGrath named his side to face Australia in a World Cup qualifying soccer match in Auckland tomorrow.
Gray was also left out of the starting linuep for New Zealand's opening World Cup match against Papua New Guinea late last month.
There were no surprises in the Australian side which was also released this morning by coach Terry Venables.
New Zealand: Jason Batty, Danny Hay, Ivan Vicelich, Gavin Wilkinson, Mark Atkinson, Simon Elliot, Michael McGarry (captain) Chris Jackson, Riki van Steeden, Wynton Rufer and Vaughen Coveny.
Australia: Mark Bosnich, Craig Moore, Steve Horvat, Alex Tobin, (captain) Robbie Slater, Stan Lazaridis, Craig Foster, Ned Zelic, Aurelio Vidmar, Graham Arnold, John Aloisi.
